headline: Nigerian Business Activity Slows in October 2026
summary: Nigeria's composite Current Business Performance Index fell to 115.4 points in October from 117.8 points in September, according to the NESG. Firms cited power supply issues, limited credit access, and infrastructure gaps as primary constraints.
why: The NESG index provides a snapshot of the health of the Nigerian private sector, which is currently struggling with macroeconomic instability.

impacts.name: Nigerian Private Sector
impacts.why: The decline in the index reflects worsening operational conditions for businesses.
